reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho and it works well enough, so I'm not adding a second tool and a bot in the site chats just to fill a sheet. I might upload an old export for the free check out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for this in a normal month.
objection: My real problem is documents that never get sent at all, and a bot that only reads what lands in the chat doesn't fix that. It just duplicates what Zoho already does for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check on my contractor's chat turned up real duplicate or padded invoices that my bookkeeper missed, I'd pay just for the watchdog on the build.
